name: UGAIL
description: Explore the people, projects, and ideas behind UGAIL.
about: UGAI-Lab is a student-led initiative that helps HKUST undergraduates take their first steps in AI research. We do this in three ways:

homeImage.alt: HKUST campus and its red sundial sculpture
homeImage.caption: A view of the HKUST campus.

aboutHeading: Where HKUST undergraduates meet AI research.

aboutItems.title: UST LabSpace
aboutItems.description: An online platform where you can keep up with faculty’s latest research directions and papers, and get matched with postgraduate researchers looking for undergraduate collaborators.

aboutItems.title: Seminars
aboutItems.description: Talks from researchers at every stage, from rising-star PhD students to faculty, on their work and how they got there.

aboutItems.title: Workshops
aboutItems.description: Conference-style sessions where students present their own work and get feedback from peers and researchers. Any stage counts: a published paper, a UROP report, a course project or an idea in progress.
